text:
Priya Nair: smoke for bronte9b-int4+quant-sched shows two issues: slab fragmentation OOMs under long-gen traffic and a tiny quality drop vs int8 on multi-turns.
Ethan Moss: can you share repro and perf numbers?
Priya Nair: repro curl: `curl -X POST /v1/generate -d '{"model":"bronte9b-int4","inputs":"Tell me a story about...","max_new_tokens":300,"batch_size":6}'`. OOMs on 3 hosts in 4h, p95 latency up when we switch to microbatching.
Ravi Kapoor: quality delta: int4 top-1 rouge drop ~1.8 points on our dialogue eval; int8 is baseline. Might be quant noise on extended context.
Ethan Moss: two-track plan: short term mitigate OOMs (slot_reserve=16MB, batch_size=3, max_new_tokens=128, enable slot_compact=true) and run a quality sweep with more seeds for int4.
Priya Nair: tried that: OOMs 18->1 over 6h, p95 +27ms, throughput -10%. Int4 quality improved on retrain-with-calib but still -0.9 rouge.
Ravi Kapoor: for long term, propose per-model quant-calibration (KL-aware) and an adaptive compaction heuristic: trigger compaction when fragmentation_ratio>0.65 AND recent_failed_allocs>0. Filing RFC-ML-112.
infra-bot: created ticket RI-9998 linking kernel slab histograms and canary logs.
Ethan Moss: add an AB canary: 10% traffic int4 with compaction+slot_reserve vs 10% int8 baseline. Collect eval p95/p99, rouge, and per-host contig-free histograms.
Priya Nair: I'll open PR with config diffs and attach reproducible script `scripts/onboard/bronte9b_smoke.sh`. Tagging @infra and @ops for rollout windows.
Ravi Kapoor: also include a short rollback plan: revert slot_reserve and max_new_tokens, and force-canary off.
Priya Nair: thanks all, will post results tomorrow after 12h AB run.
